## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON: Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; cyclicals leading and breadth threshold met, supporting the call. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Energy in Top 5) — favorable for cyclical/value exposure but concentration risks remain.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: PSX (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +9.12%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate showing upside: (sector 1W: +1.81%) and Utilities also positive: SRE/AEP headlines supporting Utilities strength.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Industrials lag: DE (1W: -7.81% | 1M: +4.84%) CORRECTION, BA (1W: -8.11% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION. Materials lag on 1W weakness: DD (1W: -5.95% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft: TSLA (1W: -5.96% | 1M: +3.45%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: OXY (1W: +12.29% | 1M: -4.01%) RECOVERY; PSX (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +9.12%) ABOVE TREND; DOW (1W: +11.12% | 1M: -11.30%) RECOVERY; MPC (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND; VLO (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Energy) — shows concentrated cyclical strength.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: DD (1W: -5.95% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND; TSLA (1W: -5.96% | 1M: +3.45%) CORRECTION; GE (1W: -6.67% | 1M: +11.03%) CORRECTION; LOW (1W: -7.19% | 1M: -3.93%) BELOW TREND; PANW (1W: -7.62% | 1M: +25.48%) CORRECTION. Weakness concentrated in Industrials/selected high-multiple names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Largest 1W movers: OXY (1W: +12.29%), PSX (1W: +11.82%), DOW (1W: +11.12%), MPC (1W: +10.37%), META (1W: +9.40%) — META (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +15.12%) ABOVE TREND confirming momentum. Major divergence present (many names with 1W ≠ 1M) — watch for trend breaks, not all momentum is broad.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with net weakness on 1W despite some leaders; META (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +15.12%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +4.08% | 1M: +1.55%) ABOVE TREND versus ORCL (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -34.41%) BELOW TREND and INTC (1W: -15.61% | 1M: -3.66%) BELOW TREND. Sector is in internal rotation with differentiated winners and losers; monitor large-cap divergence.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive: V (1W: +0.14% | 1M: +10.77%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +10.13%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.94% | 1M: +8.70%) CORRECTION but 1M strength persists. Financials are supporting the RISK-ON backdrop via 1M confirmation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing selective strength: UNH (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND while JNJ (1W: -0.60% | 1M: +8.08%) CORRECTION and LLY (1W: -1.52% | 1M: +4.00%) CORRECTION indicate rotation within the sector. Recent MRK/PFE FDA headlines (see sentiment) add a bullish catalyst for pockets of the group.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclical/value exposure given narrow but strong Energy leadership and 7/11 sector breadth, while monitoring concentration risk in Energy. Reduce exposure to clearly BELOW TREND/highly divergent names (ORCL, INTC, DD) and watch recovery setups (OXY, XOM, PFE) for tactical entries.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: PSX (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +9.12%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +10.37% | 1M: +12.76%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +15.12%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -34.41%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -15.61% | 1M: -3.66%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +8.09% | 1M: +0.72%) — breadth support from multiple large names. BEARISH: Industrials (1W: -2.42% | 1M: +5.43%) and Materials (1W: -2.33% | 1M: +0.70%) — early signs of profit-taking.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch META for continued follow-through above recent highs to confirm momentum; NVDA holding ABOVE TREND is necessary for broader tech lift. Monitor ORCL downside stability after the steep 1M drop and INTC follow-through for tech risk assessment.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (+80): PFE (1W: +3.20% | 1M: -4.38%) RECOVERY — FDA expansion headline aligns with short-term price uplift, confirming catalyst-driven accumulation. CVX (+50): CVX (1W: +8.39% | 1M: -4.00%) RECOVERY — AI/data-center & gas headlines match big 1W move. VLO (+50): VLO (1W: +9.42% | 1M: +14.65%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price are confirming strong fundamental tailwinds.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ORCL (-55): ORCL (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -34.41%) BELOW TREND — negative headlines confirm sell-off and execution concerns. DD (-75): DD (1W: -5.95% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND — litigation news tracks with price weakness. INTC (news -50 context): INTC (1W: -15.61% | 1M: -3.66%) BELOW TREND — price confirms negative sentiment and execution scrutiny.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with Value/Cyclical tilt as breadth: 7/11 sectors positive and cyclicals (notably Energy) driving leadership. META (1W: +9.40% | 1M: +15.12%) ABOVE TREND and PSX (1W: +11.82% | 1M: +9.12%) ABOVE TREND are showing clear strength. Key risk: narrow Energy concentration and major divergence across large caps (many 1W vs 1M mismatches) — watch for trend breaks and news-confirmed follow-through.
